reason: The frozen protocol's description of Matrix-08 as one 186-frame shot is superseded by the confirmed actual-shot partition. This amendment is a temporal isolation correction only; it does not introduce a new color model or relax a frozen prohibition.

per_shot_execution_contract.fit_unit: one verified actual shot at a time
per_shot: fit that shot's existing boundary-conditioned gain using only frames belonging to that shot
fit that shot's bounded low-frequency ICtCp chroma residual field using only frames belonging to that shot
freeze that shot's gain, field shape, alpha_t, alpha_p, and train-derived chroma threshold across that shot's frames
evaluate that shot independently before any cross-shot reporting aggregation
forbidden: pooling frames, pixels, gain samples, field-shape samples, alpha samples, or chroma-threshold samples across actual cuts
averaging alpha_t, alpha_p, polynomial fields, or gain parameters across shots
using a value fitted in one verified shot to transform another verified shot
merging a short or unresolved shot with another shot

train_holdout_contract.partition: Use the frozen deterministic 80/20 spatial overlap split independently within every shot.
train_only: degree-2 field shape coefficients for Ct and Cp
alpha_t and alpha_p, including declared shrinkage and bound projection
high/low chroma threshold = median(HDR base chroma | that shot's spatial TRAIN pixels)
train_holdout_contract.holdout_only: HOLDOUT is used exclusively for evaluation. The frozen per-shot threshold is applied unchanged to both that shot's TRAIN and HOLDOUT pixels.

unchanged_from_frozen_protocol: degree-2 basis [1, x, y, x^2, x*y, y^2], six coefficients per chroma channel
absolute alpha_t and alpha_p bounds of 0.25
ICtCp Ct/Cp-only low-frequency residual; I/luminance path untouched
frozen baseline, geometry, synchronization, and detail reconstruction

frame_weighting_and_reporting.within_shot_fit_weight: Each frame in a shot receives exactly 1 / shot_frame_count total temporal weight; per-pixel samples within a frame retain the frozen spatial sampling rule.
reporting: Report A versus B TRAIN and HOLDOUT metrics separately for every actual shot.
Primary criteria remain deltaE_ITP, chroma error, hue error, luminance error, and seam residual; deltaE2000 remains auxiliary only.
Only after the per-shot report, publish an equal-shot macro aggregate for descriptive reporting. Do not derive, select, or modify any fit parameter from that aggregate.
Do not report or use an averaged field or averaged alpha_t/alpha_p.

short_shot_handling.rule: A verified shot below 8 frames is UNRESOLVED_TOO_SHORT and excluded from Phase 16 fitting/report aggregation. It is never merged or pooled with another shot.
short_shot_handling.current_result: All three confirmed Matrix-08 shots are eligible: 21, 139, and 26 frames.

required_preflight: Load and validate matrix08_verified_segmentation.json: exact [73274, 73460) coverage, ordered, gap-free, non-overlapping, and all selected shots VERIFIED/eligible.
Construct and solve every fit only from a single shot's frames and its spatial TRAIN pixels.
Refuse execution if a requested frame is outside its shot, if any shot is unresolved, or if a cross-shot parameter aggregate is attempted.
